lemmas.name: nil53
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (h : minimumRightShifts_precond nums), nums.length ≤ 1 → minimumRightShifts_postcond nums 0 h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums h hn
  unfold minimumRightShifts_postcond
  dsimp only
  rw [if_pos hn]

children.invariant: j ≤ nums.length ∧ ∀ k, k < j → ¬ List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) (nums.rotateRight k)
children.result: if j < nums.length then (j : Int) else -1

lemmas.name: exit53
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (h : minimumRightShifts_precond nums) (j : Nat), ¬ nums.length ≤ 1 → (j ≤ nums.length ∧ ∀ k, k < j → ¬ List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) (nums.rotateRight k)) → ¬ (j < nums.length ∧ ¬ List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) (nums.rotateRight j)) → minimumRightShifts_postcond nums (if j < nums.length then (j : Int) else -1) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums h j hn hinv hg
  obtain ⟨hj, hk⟩ := hinv
  unfold minimumRightShifts_postcond
  dsimp only
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  by_cases hlt : j < nums.length
  · left
    have hs : List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) (nums.rotateRight j) := by
      by_contra hns
      exact hg ⟨hlt, hns⟩
    rw [if_pos hlt]
    refine ⟨by omega, by omega, by simpa using hs, ?_⟩
    rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro k hk'
    have := hk k (by simpa using hk')
    simpa using this
  · right
    have : j = nums.length := by omega
    subst this
    rw [if_neg hlt]
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro k hk'
    have := hk k (by simpa using hk')
    simpa using this
